steps.say: Tax is rounded per line, so a cart of cheap items drifts by a cent. Here is the line and the fix.

questions.question: Round tax once on the whole cart?

options.label: Once per cart (recommended)
options.description: Totals match the receipt; per-line tax shown on the invoice may differ by a cent

options.label: Per line, as now
options.description: Each line's tax is exact, the cart total can drift by a cent
